Behalten or Erhalten? German B1 Word-Choice Practice

Practise behalten for keeping and erhalten for receiving in German. Compare common object combinations with translated examples and explained B1 answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Behalten means to keep or retain something already in one's possession. Erhalten often means to receive, especially in more formal language, but it can also mean to preserve. The sentence context determines its meaning. These tasks contrast keeping an existing item with receiving a new one.

Common mistake to avoid

Erhalten does not always mean receive: ein Gebäude erhalten can mean preserving a building. Do not treat the keep/receive contrast as covering every use of the verb.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Du kannst die ausgeliehene Karte noch bis Freitag behalten.You can keep the borrowed map until Friday.
Worked example 2Ich habe gestern eine schriftliche Antwort erhalten.I received a written reply yesterday.
Worked example 3Wir behalten die alten Stühle für den Garten.We keep the old chairs for the garden.
Worked example 4Die Schule erhält eine neue Bücherspende.The school receives a new donation of books.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose behalten for retaining an existing item and erhalten for receiving in the stated context. Use the infinitive or participle as supplied. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Ich möchte diese Erinnerung für immer ___. (keep)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: behalten

Behalten expresses retaining something one already has.

Question 2. Wir haben eine Bestätigung per Post ___. (received)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: erhalten

Erhalten means received in this message context.

Question 3. Den Rest des Stoffes können wir ___. (keep for later)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: behalten

Behalten is retaining the remaining material.

Question 4. Sie hat zum Abschied viele Briefe ___. (received)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: erhalten

Erhalten is the participle for receiving the letters.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
